```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
# load data for samafs
samafs_loco = read.table("samafs_inflation_factor_loco.txt", header = TRUE)
samafs_no_loco = read.table("samafs_inflation_factor_data.txt", header = TRUE)
# load data for hchs_sol
hchs_loco = read.table("hchs_inflation_factor_loco.txt", header = TRUE)
hchs_no_loco = read.table("hchs_inflation_factor_data.txt", header = TRUE)

df_loco = gdata::combine(SAMAFS = samafs_loco, "HCHS/SOL" = hchs_loco)
df_no_loco = gdata::combine(SAMAFS = samafs_no_loco, "HCHS/SOL" = hchs_no_loco)
```

```{r}
combine_lambda_A <- merge(df_no_loco, df_loco, by = c("trait", "source")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols =  -c('trait','source'),
    names_to = c("method", "LOCO"),
    names_pattern = "(joint|meta)_(loco)?_?lambda",
    values_to = "lambda"
  ) %>%
  mutate(LOCO = ifelse(LOCO == "loco", "used", "not used")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method,
    values_from = lambda,
    names_glue = "{method}_lambda"
  )

figA <- ggplot(combine_lambda_A, aes(x = joint_lambda, y = meta_lambda)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "navy", size = 1,
              show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", size = 1,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.05,
             linetype = "solid", color = "gray", size = 1,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(LOCO),  alpha = 0.9), size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "LOCO") +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Joint analysis inflation factor",
    y = "Sex-stratified meta-analysis inflation factor"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~ source) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "cm"))

ggsave(
  filename = "supp_figA.pdf",
  plot = figA,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

```{r}
combine_lambda_B = merge(df_no_loco, df_loco, by = c("trait", "source")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c('trait','source'),
    names_to = c("method", "LOCO"),
    names_pattern = "(joint|meta)(_loco)?_lambda",
    values_to = "lambda"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    LOCO = ifelse(LOCO == "_loco", "loco", "no_loco"),
    method = ifelse(method == "meta", "sex-meta", method)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = LOCO,
    values_from = lambda
  )

figB = ggplot(combine_lambda_B, aes(x = no_loco, y = loco)) +
  # LOCO points with first color scale
  geom_point(aes(color = method, alpha = 0.9)) + 
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Analysis") +
  guides(alpha = "none") +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0, slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "navy",
    size = 1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ source) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Original inflation factor", 
    y = "LOCO inflation factor"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "supp_figB.pdf",
  plot = figB,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```
